review_locator: PMCID:PMC1904333, Hepcidin regulation: ironing out the details; PMCID:PMC5227985, Regulation of Iron Metabolism by Hepcidin under Conditions of Inflammation
primary_title: Interleukin-6 induces hepcidin expression through STAT3
decision_basis: The reviews identify IL-6/STAT3-dependent HAMP induction in hepatocytes; the cited primary shows IL-6-dependent hepcidin promoter activity, STAT3 promoter binding and STAT3 necessity/sufficiency.
limitations_preserved: Hepatocyte acute-phase model; IL-6/STAT3 promoter evidence supports HAMP transcription, while HAMP encodes the hepcidin peptide that can act downstream on ferroportin; distinguish gene transcript, processed peptide and later ferroportin biology; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC4521019, Regulation of Iron Metabolism by Hepcidin under Conditions of Inflammation; PMCID:PMC5065583, Hepcidin regulation by iron and inflammation
primary_title: Hepcidin regulation by innate immune and infectious stimuli
decision_basis: The reviews identify IL-22 as an additional inflammatory HAMP agonist converging on STAT3; the cited primary shows IL-22-induced hepcidin mRNA in Hep3B/HepG2 cells, STAT3 phosphorylation, IL-6 independence and BMP6 synergy.
limitations_preserved: Human hepatoma-cell model; IL-22/STAT3 supports HAMP transcription but BMP6 co-stimulation can amplify the output; distinguish HAMP transcript from processed hepcidin peptide and downstream iron/ferroportin effects; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMID:11865981, Haptoglobin, an inflammation-inducible plasma protein; PMCID:PMC4856808, Hepatocytes: a key cell type for innate immunity
primary_title: The carboxyl-terminal region of STAT3 controls gene induction by the mouse haptoglobin promoter
decision_basis: The reviews identify IL-6-type cytokine induction of the Hp gene through STAT3/C/EBPbeta-regulated acute-phase transcription; the cited primary shows IL-6-responsive haptoglobin promoter activity and STAT3-specific transcriptional enhancement.
limitations_preserved: Hepatoma/promoter model; STAT3 contributes to HP transcription and glucocorticoid cooperation, while haptoglobin is a secreted hemoglobin-binding protein; distinguish HP transcript from secreted protein and later Hp-Hb-CD163 scavenging; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC4856808, Hepatocytes: a key cell type for innate immunity; PMCID:PMC4050116, Regulation and function of signal transducer and activator of transcription 3
primary_title: Interleukin-6-specific activation of the C/EBPdelta gene in hepatocytes is mediated by Stat3 and Sp1
decision_basis: The reviews identify C/EBPdelta as an IL-6/STAT3-regulated hepatocyte transcription factor; the cited primary shows an IL-6-responsive CEBPD promoter element requiring STAT3 and Sp1 cooperation.
limitations_preserved: Hepatocyte promoter model; IL-6/STAT3/Sp1 regulates CEBPD transcription, which may then participate in other acute-phase gene regulation; do not infer that CEBPD alone explains all IL-6 outputs or assign terminal-TF/SCI effects.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC4856808, Hepatocytes: a key cell type for innate immunity; PMCID:PMC4074809, STAT3 Target Genes Relevant to Human Cancers
primary_title: STAT3 participates in transcriptional activation of the C-reactive protein gene by interleukin-6
decision_basis: The reviews identify IL-6/STAT3 participation in C-reactive protein transcription; the cited primary shows IL-6-responsive CRP promoter activity, STAT3 binding to the CRP acute-phase response element and enhanced endogenous CRP mRNA.
limitations_preserved: Human hepatoma promoter model; IL-6/STAT3 supports CRP transcription and CRP is a secreted acute-phase protein, with IL-1 co-stimulation in some contexts; distinguish CRP transcript from circulating protein and downstream complement/immune interactions; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.
